vb_textbox.text:
There are 2 groups of gnomes. Green, blue, orange and yellow & purple, pink, brown and red. Switch between the 2 groups of gnomes to get a higher score.
 For example, if you pick pink in the first round and it gives you a high value then stick with this group ( purple, pink, brown and red) until it changes to a lower value. Then you would choose the other group of gnomes. 
It might seem confusing at the start but you will get the hang of it the more you keep playing and noticing the change of value.
